policy.limitations: Twelve hand-authored prompts are broader targeted SDXL still-life coverage, not statistical population coverage. Exact normalized caption exclusion cannot prove semantic or pretraining independence. Counts/material/layout require direct inspection with uncertain allowed. Strength and no-trigger expectations are frozen now but base-only results cannot measure adapter behavior. ComfyUI dpmpp_2m/karras, CFG 7, 20 steps, 512px differs from the retained Diffusers diagnostics; same seeds do not establish sampler parity.
policy.method: Preregister all twelve prompts and thirty-six case/seed pairs. Freeze before baseline generation or any new tuning. Inspect both base conditions at all seeds. Later compare both adapter conditions at 0.25, 0.5 and 1.0 against the matched base controls; record all failures and uncertainty without ranking by loss or pixel differences. Legacy cases are exposed diagnostics. New holdouts are excluded from training captions, data selection and hyperparameter tuning; baseline inspection is declared exposure, not a claim of a hidden test set. Use only diagnostic regressions for C-04 development. If a holdout informs tuning, declare contamination in a new additive corpus and add fresh holdouts while preserving every old case and seed.

export.limits: Tensor names changed, payload bytes preserved; runtime acceptance is separate.

policy.limitations: Twelve hand-authored prompts are broader targeted SDXL still-life coverage, not statistical population coverage. Exact normalized caption exclusion cannot prove semantic or pretraining independence. Counts/material/layout require direct inspection with uncertain allowed. Strength and no-trigger expectations are frozen now but base-only results cannot measure adapter behavior. ComfyUI dpmpp_2m/karras, CFG 7, 20 steps, 512px differs from the retained Diffusers diagnostics; same seeds do not establish sampler parity.
policy.method: Preregister all twelve prompts and thirty-six case/seed pairs. Freeze before baseline generation or any new tuning. Inspect both base conditions at all seeds. Later compare both adapter conditions at 0.25, 0.5 and 1.0 against the matched base controls; record all failures and uncertainty without ranking by loss or pixel differences. Legacy cases are exposed diagnostics. New holdouts are excluded from training captions, data selection and hyperparameter tuning; baseline inspection is declared exposure, not a claim of a hidden test set. Use only diagnostic regressions for C-04 development. If a holdout informs tuning, declare contamination in a new additive corpus and add fresh holdouts while preserving every old case and seed.

policy.limitations: Twelve hand-authored prompts are broader targeted SDXL still-life coverage, not statistical population coverage. Exact normalized caption exclusion cannot prove semantic or pretraining independence. Counts/material/layout require direct inspection with uncertain allowed. Strength and no-trigger expectations are frozen now but base-only results cannot measure adapter behavior. ComfyUI dpmpp_2m/karras, CFG 7, 20 steps, 512px differs from the retained Diffusers diagnostics; same seeds do not establish sampler parity.
policy.method: Preregister all twelve prompts and thirty-six case/seed pairs. Freeze before baseline generation or any new tuning. Inspect both base conditions at all seeds. Later compare both adapter conditions at 0.25, 0.5 and 1.0 against the matched base controls; record all failures and uncertainty without ranking by loss or pixel differences. Legacy cases are exposed diagnostics. New holdouts are excluded from training captions, data selection and hyperparameter tuning; baseline inspection is declared exposure, not a claim of a hidden test set. Use only diagnostic regressions for C-04 development. If a holdout informs tuning, declare contamination in a new additive corpus and add fresh holdouts while preserving every old case and seed.

value.limits: Base/plain and base/trigger observations only. Trigger effects here are base-model effects. Adapter specificity/strengths and candidate acceptance remain unevaluated. Every failure and uncertain image remains in the corpus.

review.limitations: Assistant observations are disclosed, unblinded and not calibrated ground truth. No automated semantic evaluator or independent human review was used. Three seeds per prompt and twelve authored prompts do not measure a population failure rate. Surface materials, hidden interiors and detailed anatomy may be uncertain at 512px. This is a ComfyUI base-model baseline, not adapter strength/specificity evidence or controlled Diffusers parity. Baseline inspection exposes the held-out images; the declared exclusion from subsequent training/tuning remains a process constraint.
review.method: Direct visual inspection of every 512px base/plain and base/trigger image in twelve lossless two-column contact sheets, all three seeds per case. Compare each image against its frozen object, count, material, color, layout and unrelated-task expectations. Prompt adherence covers required content; image quality covers visible rendering coherence, malformed geometry and fragmented/repeated compositions. Hidden or ambiguous requirements remain uncertain. Record base token effects without attributing them to the unused adapter. No score, pixel-change threshold, loss ranking or favorable-seed deletion.
